title: DR-18, DR-1…DR-3 - Deesys Round Type Current Transformer 1.15 kV, cable through
description: Deesys round type current transformers, cable-through construction, rated up to 1.15 kV, for indoor metering. Mounting foot can be rotated 90°. Rated in ampere-turns, so the same CT covers several primary currents by changing the number of turns of the primary conductor through the window. Series: DR-18, DR-1, DR-2, DR-3.

feature_groups.title: Main Feature
items: Colour: brown; case: ABS non-flammable resin; mould: polyester
Rated in ampere-turns (AT) — primary current changes with the number of turns

rows: DR-18 : rated 75 / 100 / 120 / 150 / 200 AT, burden 5 VA, class 1.0 %, weight 0.55 kg
DR-1 : rated 100–300 AT, burden 5 VA or 5/15 VA, class 1.0 %, weight 0.55 kg
DR-2 : rated 240–600 AT, burden 15 VA or 15/40 VA, class 1.0 %, weight 0.75 kg
DR-3 : rated 500–1500 AT, burden 40 VA, class 1.0 %, weight 1.10 kg
